subject: shotgun
leg: control: Valve's own against the brief
label: shotgun, in the place of the game's models/v_shotgun.mdl, models/p_shotgun.mdl, models/w_shotgun.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_9mmar.mdl, models/w_357.mdl, models/w_egon.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked A, D, D, D where the asset was C, B, A, C: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: The outline reads as the brief's pump-action combat shotgun in every view. The long barrel and receiver run level, a thicker pump section sits mid-gun in Left and Right, and the hooked stock end shows at the bottom of Top and the top of Below, as the brief asks. Nothing sticks out or is missing.

M2.reason: Measured size is 17.1 x 3.8 x 28.2 units against the brief's 30 long: 6% short, within the 15% band.

M3.reason: The parts the brief names are there: the barrel, the dark pump (mid-gun in Left and Right, with its ribs visible in the first-person view), the folding stock, and the stock end hooked over (visible in Top and Below). The small trigger guard is hard to resolve at this scale, but I see no sign it is missing.

M4.reason: Black-grey metal with lighter steel highlights and a dark pump, as the brief asks. In first-person.png the asset's colours match the game's own shotgun beside it.

M5.reason: Ribbed pump, receiver grooves and the lavender highlight stripes on the stock and pump show in first-person.png at the same sharpness as the game's own. The streaked light and dark bands along the barrel in Left and Top are a little smeared, but they are paint, not a fault of shape, and do not show at the game's size.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the line-up test, as the rubric sets it. The asset passed the line-up for one of the game's: the judges' picks did not reliably land on it.

M7.reason: The brief names no facing. The gun lies level with its long axis across the floor in Left and Right, stock at opposite ends from opposite sides, and the hooked stock turns in Top and Below. Nothing is upside down or floating. I cannot check it against Valve's own placement from these pictures.

M8.reason: The SMAK check passes with no errors. 174 triangles is under the cap of 276 (twice the median of 138, which is above the third quartile of 187). In Below and Top the underside and body look closed, with no open faces or floating parts.

W1.reason: In first-person.png the asset sits where the game's shotgun sits, the same way round and held the same way, with the orange hand under the grip. In attack.png the hand stays under the grip from frame 0/20 through 20/20. The weapon moves with the hand and does not part from it.
